input: Create a professional email signature with my logo

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The signature may need to include specific elements beyond the logo — such as social links, disclaimers, certifications, or a tagline — which directly shapes what gets built.
Whether this is for one person or an entire team/company changes the complexity, the number of variants needed, and how names/titles are handled.
The email client or platform (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, etc.) dictates the technical format — HTML support, image hosting, size limits — and the setup steps.
Budget and time determine whether to use a paid signature tool, hire a designer, or DIY with free resources — and how polished the final result needs to be.
The desired visual style (colours, fonts, layout) must align with the brand or personal taste; a wrong style choice means rework.
The logo's current format and availability (PNG, SVG, hosted URL vs. local file) determines whether it can be embedded directly or needs preparation first.
Knowing what 'done well' looks like — a working signature installed in their email client, or just a design file to hand off — defines where the task ends.

gold.taskTitle: Create a professional email signature with logo
gold.taskDescription: Design and set up a professional email signature that incorporates the user's logo along with relevant contact and branding details.

questions.title: Which specific details should the signature include?
questions.description: Identify all elements to include beyond the logo — name, title, phone number, website, social media links, tagline, legal disclaimer, etc.

questions.title: Is this signature for you alone or multiple people?
questions.description: Determine whether one signature is needed or a scalable template is required for a team or whole company.

questions.title: Which email client or platform will you use it in?
questions.description: Identify the target email client (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, etc.) to ensure the correct technical format and installation method.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or budget for this project?
questions.description: Understand time and financial constraints to decide between DIY, a signature generator tool, or hiring a designer.

questions.title: What visual style or brand colours should it follow?
questions.description: Capture font preferences, colour palette, layout style, and any existing brand guidelines to guide the design.

questions.title: What format is your logo file currently in?
questions.description: Determine whether the logo is a PNG, SVG, or already hosted at a URL, so it can be properly embedded or prepared for use.

questions.title: Should the final signature be installed and working, or just designed?
questions.description: Clarify whether the deliverable is a ready-to-use signature set up in the email client, or a design/HTML file to be handed off.
